kind: separate physical-stock followups frozen before API execution
assumptions: Explicit neutral stocks replace incomplete bare-ion inputs; spectator ions are declared by stock formula.
Amounts, order, medium and10s are specified screening assumptions, not source-provided procedures.
No original protocol or observation is overwritten.
Qualitative expectations are not calibrated yield/rate or full mechanism validation.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expected_before_execution: Neutral solvent baseline; no added acid/base or reaction product.
